title: Pure Aquaactress
summary: Pure Aquaactress and Aquarium Continuous Spells supplemented by Wetlands, Swap Frog, Surface and WATER Extra Deck bosses. By stacking Aquarium Set, Aquarium Lighting and Wetlands, tiny Level 1 and Level 2 Aquaactresses turn into battle-immune 4000+ ATK beaters.

summary.title: Starters
points: Aquaactress Tetra (Level 1) searches any Aquarium Continuous Spell from the Deck once per turn as a soft once-per-turn effect.
Aquaactress Guppy (Level 2) Special Summons an Aquaactress monster from your hand once per turn, putting Tetra or Level 6 Arowana onto the board without Tributing.
Swap Frog sends an Aquaactress (such as Arowana or Tetra) from the Deck to the GY on summon so Surface, Marincess Coral Anemone, or a destroyed Aquarium Spell can immediately revive it.

summary.title: Opening: Guppy + Tetra (or Swap Frog + Surface)
steps: Normal Summon Aquaactress Guppy and use its effect to Special Summon Aquaactress Tetra from the hand.
Activate Tetra's effect to search Aquarium Stage, Aquarium Set or Aquarium Lighting from the Deck.
If you opened Swap Frog, send Aquaactress Arowana or Tetra to the GY and revive Tetra with Surface or Marincess Coral Anemone to trigger Tetra's soft once-per-turn search a second time.
Overlay two Level 2 Aqua monsters (Guppy and Swap Frog) into Toadally Awesome for omni-negation alongside your Aquarium back row.

summary.title: The Aquarium Suite & Wetlands Math
points: Aquarium Stage prevents your WATER monsters from being destroyed by battle with non-WATER monsters, and while you control an Aquaactress, makes them unaffected by opposing monster effects.
Aquarium Set boosts all WATER monsters by 300 ATK/DEF and all Aquaactress monsters by another 300 ATK/DEF (+600 total).

Aquarium Lighting doubles the ATK and DEF of any battling Aquaactress monster during damage calculation; combined with Wetlands (+1200 ATK to Level 2 or lower Aqua WATER monsters) and Aquarium Set (+600 ATK), a 300 ATK Tetra hits 4200 ATK and a 600 ATK Guppy hits 4800 ATK.
All three Aquarium Continuous Spells float when sent from the field to the GY by Special Summoning any Aqua monster from your GY (locking you into Aqua summons for the rest of that turn).

summary.title: Extra Deck & Support
points: Toadally Awesome detaches an Aqua material to negate and Set an opposing card, and recycles a WATER monster when sent to the GY.
Marincess Coral Anemone revives any 1500 or less ATK WATER monster (Tetra or Guppy) from the GY, and Mistar Boy boosts all WATER monsters on the field by 500 ATK.
Surface revives Tetra or Guppy in Defense Position, and Moray of Greed shuffles 2 WATER monsters back into the Deck to draw 3 cards.

allow.Swap Frog: Sends Aquaactress monsters to the GY to be revived by Aquarium Lighting/Stage and provides extra Aqua summons.
allow.Wetlands: Field Spell that gives all Level 2 or lower Aqua WATER monsters 1200 ATK, which is then doubled by Aquarium Lighting.
allow.Surface: Revives Level 3 or lower Aqua monsters like Tetra or Guppy in Defense Position to trigger their effects.
allow.Moray of Greed: Shuffles 2 WATER monsters from hand into the Deck to draw 3 cards.
allow.Toadally Awesome: Rank 2 Aqua Xyz boss accessible via Guppy and Swap Frog that provides omni-negation and recycles WATER monsters.
allow.Mistar Boy: Link-2 WATER monster that boosts all WATER monsters' ATK by 500 and recycles from GY upon destruction.
allow.Marincess Coral Anemone: Link-2 WATER monster that revives any Aquaactress from the GY.
